description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the required JSON schema (nodes with id/type/label, edges with from/to/type), valid node types (project/tool/event/person/concept/entity), valid edge types (causes/enables/requires/relates/affects), and the deduplication + slug-ID conventions. (2) Parse all three input source types: memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md files, MEMORY.md, and .issues/open-*.md files. (3) Extract entities by category: people (瓜农, 龙虾, Jason Zuo → type=person), projects (AgentAwaken, NeuroBoost, ClawWork → type=project), tools (GitHub, Vercel, ClawHub → type=tool), concepts (永续记忆, 三层架构 → type=concept). (4) Extract timestamped events (e.g., NeuroBoost v5.0 发布 on 2026-02-26) with type=event and a timestamp field. (5) Apply causal pattern matching using Chinese keywords (因为/由于/导致/所以 → causes; 使得/让/允许 → enables; 需要/依赖/基于 → requires) to infer edges with correct proprietary type names. (6) Deduplicate entities — 'agentawaken' and 'AgentAwaken' and 'agent-awaken repo' must all resolve to a single node with id='agent-awaken' and label='AgentAwaken'. (7) Ensure all node IDs are slug-format (lowercase, hyphen-separated). (8) Produce at minimum 8 nodes and 5 edges. The key traps are: using wrong edge types (e.g., 'caused_by' instead of 'causes'), missing the timestamp field on event nodes, non-slug IDs, duplicate nodes for the same entity, and omitting person-type nodes entirely.
